chrome.limits: Chrome on macOS; mobile sizes are desktop Chrome device emulation, not physical devices. 200% material/typography captures precede the later music button; its final header was checked at desktop, 320 and 740 widths. Native Chrome reported actual audio playback; waveform/subjective loudspeaker listening was not measured. Screenshots stay local because browser chrome includes unrelated personal tab titles.

assetNotes.loading: Album module and textures load after opening; closing-letter font, cutout and stickers are used on the letter. Existing bounded photograph loading preserved.
assetNotes.cutout: Generated from the supplied smiling photograph using imagegen background extraction. Preserves photographic likeness but may reconstruct small edge details; not a pixel-identical masking claim. Original private photograph is not bundled.
